title: Could be better
text: Could be better. All in all, it's a decent light for a young child, but it could be much better. The unicorn looks very odd, with all those lines all over it's body, it's distracting. Other lights like this tend to have two or three patterns for the same price as well. A wall plug would have nice, but I know these rarely come with those and you have to get them yourself.  Not trying to talk anyone out of getting this one, it is perfectly ok. If you like the pattern, and the price, then get it, it came as advertised and works fine. But it could be much better.
